name: @pres/professor-slides-skills
description: Course source resolution, outline checking and deck rendering for the professor-slides-skills plugin. Ported from ProfessorHarness node/ and ProfessorExoskeletonDHS exo/.
//optionalDependencies: Reading a course must not require a native image library or a Postgres driver. `pg` is only needed for the Supabase route, `pptxgenjs` and `sharp` only for `pres render`; a machine where any of them fails to install still resolves a YAML course and still runs `npm test`.
